Just a quick re-upload of my Refined Character Creator, for posterity and exposure: https://perchance.org/ai-character-chat?data=Refined_Character_Creator~42d0ae649b939cfa0f13c69214cf3622.gz

Makes a character from as little or as much info as you provide, and has a format that is easy to read and edit. 

And the link to the shared character gallery: perchance.org/shared-characters-from-ai-character-chat-comments


localdutchie shared a butchered version of my bot in perchance.org/shared-characters-from-ai-character-chat-comments (generically called "Character Creator") but forgot to change my intro message (still calls it "Refined Character Creator"). Sloppy af 😂 But it seems to be a less detailed creator, if that's your bag.
